purpose: Non-admission research registry of original datasets traced from scientific flood and building-damage papers, requiring independent source rights, data provenance and model-use checks.

entries.name: CFDID China Flood Disaster Impact Database v1.1
entries.provider: Cui et al. / Tsinghua University / Zenodo
entries.spatial_scope: Chinese mainland; chiefly province-level reported locations, sometimes more detailed text names
entries.temporal_scope: Original events 1994-2023; frozen dataset v1.1 released 2026-09-23; paper published 2026-11-05
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 1,716 reported hierarchical event records: 1,391 parent L1, 300 nested L2, 25 nested L3; eight human/economic/cropland/dwelling impact indicators from 66 official documents; v1.1 includes data dictionary, code, annual benchmark totals and EM-DAT event crosswalk
entries.note: Peer reviewed https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-18-8129-2026. Sources include China Water Resources Yearbook, Yearbook of Meteorological Disasters in China, and Top Ten Natural Disasters in China; China Flood and Drought Bulletin duplicates some yearbook statistics. Never add L2/L3 economic losses to their L1 parents. Original 2026 EGU conference abstract mentions different 1949-2023 / 15k scope: do not conflate with published 1994-2023 / 1,716 v1.1. Derived aggregate reported impacts are not measured flood depth, insured property losses, or a complete event-frequency catalogue. Missing values not zero, CNY nominal vs 2023-constant disjoint. Version rights, per-file SHA and official-document third-party re-use not independently reviewed.

entries.name: EO4FLOOD Advanced Open Earth Observation Dataset v2
entries.provider: Tarpanelli et al. / ESA EO4FLOOD consortium / Zenodo
entries.spatial_scope: Nine basins: Brahmaputra, Congo, Danube, Ebro, Negro, Niger, Po, Rhine and Torne
entries.temporal_scope: Research dataset v2 released 2026-07-30; sensor-specific observation coverage and temporal alignment vary
entries.resolution_or_granularity: About 60.2 GB across basin ZIP archives; precipitation, soil moisture, river water level, river discharge, flood extent, river width, snow and remote-sensing features plus Jupyter notebooks
entries.note: Associated 2026 paper https://doi.org/10.1007/s10712-026-09935-w. Preserve v2 distinct from superseded v1 17787732. Public Zenodo CC BY 4.0 record does not settle embedded satellite/provider rights. This compilation contains multiple distinct observed and processed variables, not uniform independent measurements; evaluate each layer's origin, timestamps, CRS, datum, missingness and downstream derivative rights. No original ZIP, data values or insured losses imported.

entries.name: European multi-input observed-flood-inundation patches v1 (Randall 2026)
entries.spatial_scope: Seven events in France, Italy, Greece, Poland, Slovakia, Hungary and Germany
entries.temporal_scope: European flood events 2019-2024; publication 2026-10-19, version v1
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 3,027 geographically referenced 256 x 256 multi-resolution patches with local/nearby/context inputs and 3-class Copernicus EMS target labels
entries.note: Upstream inputs: FABDEM, NASA IMERG, Sentinel-2, ESA WorldCover, OSM water features, NASA SMAP, ISRIC SoilGrids. Label is CEMS flood extent; value 0 non-AOI must not be read as observed dry land. FABDEM's CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 rights are a commercial reuse blocker pending explicit permission. CEMS input labels cannot also be independent validation. Keep splits by physical event, not arbitrary chips. Model code: https://github.com/Natasha-R/Flood-Prediction-Deep-Learning. No claims of observed loss, return-period maps or insurer TIV.

entries.name: Keeney-Davenport EM-DAT/MODIS flood admin1-month research package v1
entries.provider: Nicole J. Keeney and Frances V. Davenport / Zenodo / Colorado State University
entries.spatial_scope: 177 countries and 2,375 first-level administrative regions in 2000-2024 research sample
entries.temporal_scope: 2000-2024 event observations; source code v1 published 2025-12-12, 2026-09-29 peer-review preprint
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Preprint reports 4,073 inland EM-DAT events disaggregated to 23,334 admin1-month records with MODIS detected flood area and gridded exposed population; public Zenodo v1 software archive about 42.6 MB including sample outputs and CSVs; full per-event floodmap set not established as published
entries.note: ESSD 2026 peer-review preprint https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-2026-577, not yet a final accepted paper. Parent EM-DAT records and already registered event datasets are not independent loss observations. MODIS inundation estimates depend on clouds/detection method; administrative polygon and calendar-month labels are NOT observed exact flood footprints or dates. Dataset ZIP contains reference CSVs and only example floodmaps according to provider release. Recheck license of EM-DAT-derived data, satellite and gridded population inputs before redistribution or commercial use.

entries.name: Marche 2022 surveyed residential and industrial flood damage – fixed Zenodo v1.0.1
entries.provider: Rrokaj et al. / University of Florence / Zenodo
entries.spatial_scope: Italian Marche region: Ostra, Senigallia, Trecastelli; Misa River basin
entries.temporal_scope: 2022-09-15 flood, field observations collected 2022-10 through 2022-12; paper published 2025-11-25
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 256 UNIQUE primary surveyed properties by original Form A: industrial/commercial 133, residential 123; source has 2 independently SHA-256-verified ZIPs (929330 and 891047 bytes), 5 workbooks A-E plus 7/9-sheet data dictionaries, 3 header rows, multiple secondary sheets and privacy-sensitive coordinates
entries.note: Peer-reviewed paper https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-17-6487-2025 references concept/all-version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15591850; exact latest inspected original Zenodo release is v1.0.1 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17457884, published 2025-10-27. Original industrial ZIP SHA-256 a4e5a142450e3a9c63e0dcb964b674a55ca180a7c44ec852ecd8e48638d29847; residential ZIP SHA-256 4785f5eae8940e5c8033758aac11d1b2d8b7e5f75fe19efab497dfd5453802cd. Both original publisher MD5 values matched exactly. Real privacy-safe Form-A structural QA and 11 synthetic tests: docs/research/marche-2022-original-zip-privacy-gate-20261108.md. Original source has individual geocoordinates, business/property details and 1-to-many form relationships; no redistributable microdata, coordinates, names or addresses in Git. The publication's 247/256 water-depth availability is not independently validated for depth accuracy or model feasibility by this structural audit. Copernicus EMSR634 informed survey site selection and is not independent from that sample. Rights review and scientific model admission remain not_reviewed/not_admitted; no observed insured claim data, independent national census or stochastic event frequency.
